scope: The complete 413-token drž/soderž/sadrž/sodrž family in the current Latin reader.
choice: Use canonical sodrživati for mathematical containment and sodržanje for content: normalize 387 inflected tokens mechanically, recast one semantic-content phrase as smyslovom soglasju, keep nine already-canonical content nouns, and preserve sixteen distinct držati/zadržati tokens. Never use sodržati for containment because its official meaning is hold back/inhibit.
motivation: The inherited text mixed Russian-like soderž-, South-like sadrž-, and partially normalized sodrž- paradigms, sometimes using forms that look like sodržati even though the official containment verb is sȯdŕživati. One canonical type-appropriate family removes the internal national mixture while retaining transparent morphology. The content noun is separately official; the one phrase about agreement in meaning is clearer as smyslovom soglasju than as a containment noun.
alternatives_rejected: Normalize containment to sodržati; official id 72 means hold back/inhibit, not contain.
Keep a Russian soderž- versus South sadrž- doublet; that reproduces the national-source mixture instead of an Interslavic paradigm.
Use imati for every containment relation; it is broad but erases the technical distinction between having and containing.
Treat držati and zadržati as spelling errors; their sixteen contexts use separate official hold/retain meanings.

official_grammar.application: The productive -ivati stem and standard present/participle rules yield sodrživaje, sodrživajut, sodrživajuči and sodrživany.

validation.partition: 387 changed + 1 semantic recast + 9 canonical content + 16 protected distinct lexemes = 413
validation.type_coverage: all 68 observed case-sensitive types accounted for
validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
